LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_RescueHelp: Send up to four people from the same beacon home to rescue survivors or recover items. Rescue does not restart the challenge or grant progression.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_ManageHelp: Manage departure, retreat and recovery from the current ascension trial.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_EnrollHelp: Bring up to three helpers. The candidate must complete personal objectives; returning preserves injuries and deaths.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_GatherHelp: A conscious colonist must stand beside the gateway. Bring people, bodies and supplies within 6 cells. Put carried cargo down before departure.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Empty: No people or supplies are close enough to the gateway.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Selection: Selected: {0}. Independent map objects: {1} (carried contents excluded). Unselected contents stay here.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_RetreatConfirm: Retreat and end this challenge? You will earn no new node; reserved awakening materials are refunded. Unselected people and supplies remain on the trial map.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_AbandonConfirm: {0} people or objects remain here. Permanently abandoning this site removes its map and everything left behind.\n\nAbandon the site?
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Changed: The expedition has changed. Check its current state and try again.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Origin: The departure beacon or its colony is no longer available.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Party: The selected party is not ready to depart.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Hands: Put carried people and items down first. Worn equipment and inventory travel with their owner.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Reach: Every participant must be able to reach the beacon.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Map: The trial map could not be prepared. The expedition remains available for recovery.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Space: There is not enough clear landing space near the destination. Clear the area or choose another destination.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Move: The transfer was interrupted. Check the retained trial map before retrying.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Destination: This return destination is no longer available. Choose another colony or form a caravan.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_World: A caravan cannot form on this world layer. Choose a colony destination.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Gather: Some selected people or supplies are no longer near the gateway. Refresh the list.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_Operator: Select a conscious colonist beside the gateway who can reach everyone and everything you want to take.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_EnrollmentChanged: The applicant, source, resources or trial requirements have changed. Check the node before enrolling again.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_PostReturnHelp: Recover people, bodies and supplies from anywhere on the finished trial map. Carried contents and inventory travel with their owner; unselected contents stay here.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_CaravanHelp: A world caravan still needs at least one conscious, able colonist in the selection.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_EmptyAll: No friendly people, bodies or supplies on this map can be returned.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_SelectionEmpty: Select at least one person, body or item to return.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_SelectionChanged: Selected contents no longer belong to this trial or cannot be returned. Refresh the list and select again.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_CaravanLeader: A world caravan needs a conscious, able colonist. Select one or return to a colony instead.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_CarriedOther: A selected person is carrying a non-player pawn or an unsupported object. Put it down before returning.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_RewardTierRule: Current T{0}. First victory unlocks the node; later T1–T6 victories grant +1–+6 refinement levels.
LanguageData.RHA_StarTravel030_RewardLimit: This node has reached the refinement-count limit.
